fbattle.title: Preset Actions
fbattle.info: Choose each character's first-turn action; on a selected skill, the arrows set its burst. Burst 0 still casts the skill, and later turns follow the game. Drag sideways for more actions.
fbattle.sp_partial: Chosen actions: {0} / {1} SP (excludes characters following the game)
fbattle.save_failed: Save failed. Your changes remain open; please try again.
fbattle.open_failed: Unable to open the action editor. Please check the plugin log.
fbattle.empty: Add characters to the preset first.
fbattle.confirm.title: Save preset actions?
fbattle.confirm.message: Your action changes have not been saved. Save also saves this preset's characters, positions and equipment. Discard leaves the actions unchanged. Cancel returns to editing.
fbattle.server_required: This server does not support preset actions. Please update the server.
fbattle.request_failed: Unable to load or save preset actions. Please try again later.
